findings.summary: Plan-time KERNEL-PLAN-LINEAGE refusals, returned to the driver and counted in cont.repairs, are dropped (NOT_REFUSALS intersection also drops mixed findings).
An answer outcome with status UNKNOWN (verifier raised) is a kernel repair or terminal refusal but the report counts only FAILED.
The profile repair budget limitation is stated only in a code comment, not in METRICS_NOTE or the design doc.
Later plan steps out of the denominator and the STALE next-state test are accepted.
